title: Complaining and Quail

questions.question: What did the people complain about at Taberah?
questions.explanation: Numbers 11:1 (ESV): "And the people complained in the hearing of the Lord about their misfortunes..."

questions.question: How did God respond to the complaints at Taberah?
options: His anger was kindled and fire burned among them
questions.correctAnswer: His anger was kindled and fire burned among them
questions.explanation: Numbers 11:1 (ESV): "...the fire of the Lord burned among them and consumed some outlying parts of the camp."

questions.question: What food did the people crave?
options: Meat (specifically fish, cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions, garlic)
questions.correctAnswer: Meat (specifically fish, cucumbers, melons, leeks, onions, garlic)
questions.explanation: Numbers 11:4-5 (ESV): "The rabble... had a strong craving... We remember the fish... cucumbers... melons..."

questions.question: Moses felt burdened. What did God do to help him?
options: Appointed seventy elders to bear the burden with him
questions.correctAnswer: Appointed seventy elders to bear the burden with him
questions.explanation: Numbers 11:16-17 (ESV): "Gather for me seventy men of the elders... they shall bear the burden of the people with you."

questions.question: What meat did God provide?
questions.explanation: Numbers 11:31 (ESV): "Then a wind from the Lord sprang up, and it brought quail from the sea..."

questions.question: How much quail did God promise to give them?
options: A whole month, until it comes out of your nostrils
questions.correctAnswer: A whole month, until it comes out of your nostrils
questions.explanation: Numbers 11:20 (ESV): "But a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils and becomes loathsome to you..."

questions.question: What happened when the Spirit rested on the seventy elders?
questions.explanation: Numbers 11:25 (ESV): "And as soon as the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied. But they did not continue doing it."

questions.question: Who were the two men who remained in the camp and prophesied?
questions.explanation: Numbers 11:26 (ESV): "Two men remained in the camp... The name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad."

questions.question: How did Joshua respond to Eldad and Medad prophesying?
questions.explanation: Numbers 11:28 (ESV): "Joshua... said, 'My lord Moses, stop them.'"

questions.question: What was Moses' response to Joshua?
options: "Are you jealous for my sake? Would that all the Lord's people were prophets!"
questions.correctAnswer: "Are you jealous for my sake? Would that all the Lord's people were prophets!"
questions.explanation: Numbers 11:29 (ESV): "Are you jealous for my sake? Would that all the Lord's people were prophets..."

questions.question: What happened while the meat was yet between their teeth?
options: The anger of the Lord was kindled and he struck them with a plague
questions.correctAnswer: The anger of the Lord was kindled and he struck them with a plague
questions.explanation: Numbers 11:33 (ESV): "While the meat was yet between their teeth... the Lord struck the people with a very great plague."

questions.question: What does "Kibroth-hattaavah" mean?
questions.explanation: Numbers 11:34 (ESV): "Called... Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had the craving."

questions.question: How deep were the quail piled around the camp?
questions.explanation: Numbers 11:31 (ESV): "About two cubits above the face of the earth."

questions.question: What does "Taberah" mean?
questions.explanation: Numbers 11:3 (ESV): "So the name of that place was called Taberah (burning), because the fire of the Lord burned among them."

questions.question: Where did the Spirit come from that was put on the elders?
options: From the Spirit that was on Moses
questions.correctAnswer: From the Spirit that was on Moses
questions.explanation: Numbers 11:17 (ESV): "I will take some of the Spirit that is on you and put it on them."

key_verse_text: But Moses said to him, 'Are you jealous for my sake? Would that all the Lord's people were prophets, that the Lord would put his Spirit on them!'
